title: Leak-Tight Versus RTO Requirement Sorter
description: Twelve requirement cards from FanPedia's nominally leak-tight and RTO construction pages, dealt in one shuffled order (seed 21). The learner places each card in Leak-Tight Only, Both or RTO Only and locks it, one attempt each, with mastery at 10 of 12 on the first attempt; afterwards the two lists are shown side by side with the five shared lines linked.

educational.audience: Adult professional development: new application engineers, sales staff, representatives and facilities staff
educational.topic: Nominally leak-tight versus RTO construction requirements
learningObjectives: The learner will differentiate FanPedia's nominally leak-tight and RTO construction requirements by sorting 12 requirements into Leak-Tight Only, RTO Only, or Both, with at least 10 of 12 correct on the first attempt.

accessibility.notes: describe() text (fallback mode); selections and verdicts announced through FP.announce (aria-live); ✓/✗ glyphs, solid/dashed chip and feedback borders pair with colour; bin buttons carry aria-pressed; keys 1-3 choose a bin, Enter locks or goes to the next card.

controls.label: 1 Leak-Tight Only / 2 Both / 3 RTO Only
controls.purpose: Choose a bin for the face-up card (keys 1-3)

controls.label: Lock placement
controls.purpose: Lock the placement; it is scored and cannot be moved (Enter)

controls.label: Next card / Finish
controls.purpose: Turn up the next card; after card 12, show the summary (Enter)

controls.label: Compare the two lists / Show the bins
controls.purpose: After the last card: the leak-tight and RTO lists side by side with shared lines linked

controls.label: Start over
controls.purpose: Deal all twelve cards again and clear the score

rules: One bin per card; correctness is an exact match with the spec's Bin column.
Cards are dealt in a shuffled order seeded by 21, the same for every learner; Start over continues the seeded stream.
One attempt per card; a locked placement cannot be changed.
Score: n of 12 correct; mastery is 10 of 12 on the first attempt.
limitations: Construction details vary by model; FanPedia refers to Fan Engineering Letter FE-700 for leak-tight details.

sources: FanPedia: The Fan & Blower Encyclopedia (2021 edition), p. 120 (nominally leak-tight) and p. 121 (RTO)

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Sorting near-identical requirement lists into shared and distinct bins, then comparing the two lists side by side
keyQuestions: Which requirements appear on both pages?
Which requirements only a leak-tight fan carries?
Which requirements only RTO duty adds?
How many of the 12 requirements are shared?
commonMisconceptions: RTO construction is just leak-tight construction under another name.
Leak-tight fans may be any arrangement.
Silicone gasketing is acceptable on every RTO job.
